home.title: Syed Ahmad Geelani — Full-Stack Developer
home.description: Portfolio of Syed Ahmad Geelani, a full-stack developer and Computer Science (AI) undergraduate in Kuala Lumpur. Explore software projects, creative engineering, and Veltr Studio.

framecheck.title: Framecheck — Browser-based visual QA | Syed Ahmad Geelani
framecheck.description: Case study: Framecheck, a local-first visual QA tool that compares screenshots pixel by pixel in the browser using Pixelmatch, Web Workers, Zustand and IndexedDB.

synesthesia.title: SYNESTHESIA — Real-time audio visualization | Syed Ahmad Geelani
synesthesia.description: Case study: SYNESTHESIA, a browser audio visualizer built with React Three Fiber, custom GLSL shaders, the Web Audio API and an AudioWorklet analysis pipeline.

parallel.title: PARALLEL — Branching interactive fiction | Syed Ahmad Geelani
parallel.description: Case study: PARALLEL, an authored branching-narrative app with deterministic state reconstruction, local persistence and strict import validation.
